#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""GMRI deterministic discovery/triage engine. No LLM claims of verification."""
import argparse, csv, hashlib, json, re, sqlite3, urllib.request, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCES={
 'cisa_alerts':('government','https://www.cisa.gov/cybersecurity-advisories/all.xml'),
 'bleepingcomputer':('specialist','https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/feed/'),
 'hackernews':('community','https://hnrss.org/newest?q=cyberattack'),
 'reddit_netsec':('community','https://www.reddit.com/r/netsec/.rss'),
 'reddit_sysadmin':('community','https://www.reddit.com/r/sysadmin/.rss'),
 'reddit_worldnews':('community','https://www.reddit.com/r/worldnews/.rss'),
 'github_security':('technical','https://github.com/advisories.atom'),
 'krebs':('specialist','https://krebsonsecurity.com/feed/'),
 'therecord':('specialist','https://therecord.media/feed'),
}
# Sources without dependable public feeds are explicitly tracked as discovery gaps.
MANUAL_CHANNELS=['X','Bluesky','Mastodon','Telegram','Discord','Facebook local groups','local news','YouTube','independent journalist newsletters']
TERMS={
 'cyber_physical':r'cooling|refrigerat|freezer|industrial control|scada|plc|water treatment|power grid|substation|hospital|medical device|food supply',
 'state_cyber':r'north korea|dprk|russia|iran|china|state.sponsored|apt\b|military|pentagon|defense',
 'financial':r'crypto|bank|swift|exchange|billion|launder|sanction|ransomware|funds stolen',
 'governance':r'election|regulat|oversight|corrupt|cover.up|whistleblow|court|congress',
 'ai':r'artificial intelligence|\bai\b|autonomous|agentic|model deployment|data center',
}
IMPACT=[(r'killed|fatalit|death|patient|hospital|ambulance',5),(r'power grid|water treatment|food supply|refrigerat|freezer|military|pentagon',4),(r'billion|ransomware|election|state.sponsored',3)]

def canonical(s):
 s=re.sub(r'https?://','',s.lower());s=re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9 ]',' ',s)
 return ' '.join(w for w in s.split() if w not in {'the','a','an','of','in','on','and','to','for','with'})

def init(db):
 db.executescript('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS discoveries (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source TEXT,source_class TEXT,title TEXT,url TEXT,published TEXT,first_seen TEXT,domains TEXT,impact INTEGER,urgency INTEGER,status TEXT,raw_hash TEXT);
 CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS observations (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, discovery_id TEXT, note TEXT, evidence_state TEXT, source_url TEXT);
 CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS links (a TEXT,b TEXT,relation TEXT,evidence_state TEXT,shared_terms TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(a,b,relation));
 CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs (run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,started TEXT,feeds_ok INTEGER,feeds_failed INTEGER,items_seen INTEGER,items_new INTEGER,errors TEXT);''')

def parse_feed(blob):
 root=ET.fromstring(blob);out=[]
 for e in root.findall('.//item'):
  def t(k):return (e.findtext(k) or '').strip()
  out.append((t('title'),t('link'),t('pubDate')))
 for e in root.findall('{http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom}entry'):
  link=e.find('{http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom}link')
  out.append(((e.findtext('{http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom}title') or '').strip(),link.get('href','') if link is not None else '',e.findtext('{http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom}updated') or ''))
 return [x for x in out if x[0] and x[1]]

def score(title):
 domains=[k for k,p in TERMS.items() if re.search(p,title,re.I)]
 impact=max((n for p,n in IMPACT if re.search(p,title,re.I)),default=1)
 urgency=min(10,impact+min(3,len(domains))+int('cyber_physical' in domains))
 return domains,impact,urgency

def ingest(db,source,klass,title,url,published,now):
 # Preserve source URL and first-seen; do not treat the title as verified evidence.
 ident=hashlib.sha256((source+'|'+url).encode()).hexdigest()[:20]
 domains,impact,urgency=score(title)
 raw_hash=hashlib.sha256((title+'|'+url+'|'+published).encode()).hexdigest()
 cur=db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO discoveries VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(ident,source,klass,title,url,published,now,','.join(domains),impact,urgency,'UNVERIFIED_LEAD',raw_hash))
 return cur.rowcount

def correlate(db):
 # Suggest candidate relationships only. Shared category is NEVER proof of a shared actor.
 rows=db.execute('SELECT id,title,domains FROM discoveries').fetchall()
 for i,(a,ta,da) in enumerate(rows):
  wa=set(canonical(ta).split());ca=set(da.split(','))-set([''])
  for b,tb,dbs in rows[i+1:]:
   wb=set(canonical(tb).split());cb=set(dbs.split(','))-set([''])
   overlap=wa&wb
   if len(overlap)>=3 and ca&cb:
    db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO links VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',(a,b,'candidate_overlap','UNVERIFIED',','.join(sorted(overlap))))

def main():
 p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--fixture',help='JSON list of source/title/url/published');p.add_argument('--live',action='store_true');p.add_argument('--db',default=str(ROOT/'threat_discovery.sqlite'));a=p.parse_args()
 db=sqlite3.connect(a.db);init(db);now=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat();ok=fail=seen=new=0;errors=[]
 if a.fixture:
  for x in json.loads(Path(a.fixture).read_text()):
   seen+=1;new+=ingest(db,x['source'],x.get('source_class','unknown'),x['title'],x['url'],x.get('published',''),now)
  ok=1
 if a.live:
  for name,(klass,url) in SOURCES.items():
   try:
    req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'GMRI-Research/1.0 (public feed reader)'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=8) as response: items=parse_feed(response.read(2_000_000))
    ok+=1
    for title,link,published in items[:100]:
     seen+=1;new+=ingest(db,name,klass,title,link,published,now)
   except Exception as ex:
    fail+=1;errors.append({'source':name,'error':str(ex)[:180]})
 correlate(db);db.execute('INSERT INTO runs VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(hashlib.sha256(now.encode()).hexdigest()[:12],now,ok,fail,seen,new,json.dumps(errors)));db.commit()
 print(json.dumps({'feeds_ok':ok,'feeds_failed':fail,'items_seen':seen,'new_leads':new,'candidate_links':db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM links').fetchone()[0],'errors':errors,'manual_channels_not_automatically_collected':MANUAL_CHANNELS},indent=2))
 for row in db.execute('SELECT title,urgency,source,status FROM discoveries ORDER BY urgency DESC LIMIT 12'):print('PRIORITY',row)
if __name__=='__main__':main()

# GMRI threat discovery and correlation engine — executable prototype

## What is implemented

`threat_logic.py` ingests RSS/Atom sources or a JSON fixture; records first-seen timestamps, source provenance, raw-record hashes, incident domain tags and human-impact triage; deduplicates by source+URL; proposes candidate overlap links; and logs collection failures. SQLite records persist across runs. Candidate links are explicitly UNVERIFIED and cannot be promoted to shared-actor claims by the algorithm.

## Running

`python threat_logic.py --fixture THREAT_LOGIC_FIXTURE.json`

`python threat_logic.py --live`

`python threat_logic.py --fixture LIVE_DISCOVERY_2026-11-01.json`

## Scope and limitations

The fixture test ran twice: first run created 3 leads, second created 0 (deduplication works); one overlap candidate was produced. The live-news discovery fixture contains 6 additional leads located by web search on November 1, 2026; these were ingested but **not authenticated from original bytes**. Some aggregator leads use a listing URL, not a stable individual-article URL; do not treat them as source-level proof. RSS live collection is implemented but was not run in this execution. Some feeds may be unavailable or deny automated access; failed feeds are logged, never silently counted as successful. X, Bluesky, Telegram, Discord, Mastodon, local Facebook groups, YouTube, and newsletters require connectors or approved retrieval paths and are currently manual discovery gaps. This prototype does not run unattended and has no background scheduler.

## Essential next engineering controls

Source snapshots and content hashes, normalized event dates, cross-source corroboration, human impact scoring based on incident data rather than headlines, explicit evidence graph, adversarial alternative hypotheses, review of misleading near-duplicates, and an actual recurring scheduled run. **A candidate match is a question to investigate, not an answer.**

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""GMRI deterministic discovery/triage engine. No LLM claims of verification."""
import argparse, csv, hashlib, json, re, sqlite3, urllib.request, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCES={
 'cisa_alerts':('government','https://www.cisa.gov/cybersecurity-advisories/all.xml'),
 'bleepingcomputer':('specialist','https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/feed/'),
 'hackernews':('community','https://hnrss.org/newest?q=cyberattack'),
 'reddit_netsec':('community','https://www.reddit.com/r/netsec/.rss'),
 'reddit_sysadmin':('community','https://www.reddit.com/r/sysadmin/.rss'),
 'reddit_worldnews':('community','https://www.reddit.com/r/worldnews/.rss'),
 'github_security':('technical','https://github.com/advisories.atom'),
 'krebs':('specialist','https://krebsonsecurity.com/feed/'),
 'therecord':('specialist','https://therecord.media/feed'),
}
# Sources without dependable public feeds are explicitly tracked as discovery gaps.
MANUAL_CHANNELS=['X','Bluesky','Mastodon','Telegram','Discord','Facebook local groups','local news','YouTube','independent journalist newsletters']
TERMS={
 'cyber_physical':r'cooling|refrigerat|freezer|industrial control|scada|plc|water treatment|power grid|substation|hospital|medical device|food supply',
 'state_cyber':r'north korea|dprk|russia|iran|china|state.sponsored|apt\b|military|pentagon|defense',
 'financial':r'crypto|bank|swift|exchange|billion|launder|sanction|ransomware|funds stolen',
 'governance':r'election|regulat|oversight|corrupt|cover.up|whistleblow|court|congress',
 'ai':r'artificial intelligence|\bai\b|autonomous|agentic|model deployment|data center',
}
IMPACT=[(r'killed|fatalit|death|patient|hospital|ambulance',5),(r'power grid|water treatment|food supply|refrigerat|freezer|military|pentagon',4),(r'billion|ransomware|election|state.sponsored',3)]

def canonical(s):
 s=re.sub(r'https?://','',s.lower());s=re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9 ]',' ',s)
 return ' '.join(w for w in s.split() if w not in {'the','a','an','of','in','on','and','to','for','with'})

def init(db):
 db.executescript('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS discoveries (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source TEXT,source_class TEXT,title TEXT,url TEXT,published TEXT,first_seen TEXT,domains TEXT,impact INTEGER,urgency INTEGER,status TEXT,raw_hash TEXT);
 CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS observations (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, discovery_id TEXT, note TEXT, evidence_state TEXT, source_url TEXT);
 CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS links (a TEXT,b TEXT,relation TEXT,evidence_state TEXT,shared_terms TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(a,b,relation));
 CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs (run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,started TEXT,feeds_ok INTEGER,feeds_failed INTEGER,items_seen INTEGER,items_new INTEGER,errors TEXT);''')

def parse_feed(blob):
 root=ET.fromstring(blob);out=[]
 for e in root.findall('.//item'):
  def t(k):return (e.findtext(k) or '').strip()
  out.append((t('title'),t('link'),t('pubDate')))
 for e in root.findall('{http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom}entry'):
  link=e.find('{http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom}link')
  out.append(((e.findtext('{http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom}title') or '').strip(),link.get('href','') if link is not None else '',e.findtext('{http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom}updated') or ''))
 return [x for x in out if x[0] and x[1]]

def score(title):
 domains=[k for k,p in TERMS.items() if re.search(p,title,re.I)]
 impact=max((n for p,n in IMPACT if re.search(p,title,re.I)),default=1)
 urgency=min(10,impact+min(3,len(domains))+int('cyber_physical' in domains))
 return domains,impact,urgency

def ingest(db,source,klass,title,url,published,now):
 # Preserve source URL and first-seen; do not treat the title as verified evidence.
 ident=hashlib.sha256((source+'|'+url).encode()).hexdigest()[:20]
 domains,impact,urgency=score(title)
 raw_hash=hashlib.sha256((title+'|'+url+'|'+published).encode()).hexdigest()
 cur=db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO discoveries VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(ident,source,klass,title,url,published,now,','.join(domains),impact,urgency,'UNVERIFIED_LEAD',raw_hash))
 return cur.rowcount

def correlate(db):
 # Suggest candidate relationships only. Shared category is NEVER proof of a shared actor.
 rows=db.execute('SELECT id,title,domains FROM discoveries').fetchall()
 for i,(a,ta,da) in enumerate(rows):
  wa=set(canonical(ta).split());ca=set(da.split(','))-set([''])
  for b,tb,dbs in rows[i+1:]:
   wb=set(canonical(tb).split());cb=set(dbs.split(','))-set([''])
   overlap=wa&wb
   if len(overlap)>=3 and ca&cb:
    db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO links VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',(a,b,'candidate_overlap','UNVERIFIED',','.join(sorted(overlap))))

def main():
 p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--fixture',help='JSON list of source/title/url/published');p.add_argument('--live',action='store_true');p.add_argument('--db',default=str(ROOT/'threat_discovery.sqlite'));a=p.parse_args()
 db=sqlite3.connect(a.db);init(db);now=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat();ok=fail=seen=new=0;errors=[]
 if a.fixture:
  for x in json.loads(Path(a.fixture).read_text()):
   seen+=1;new+=ingest(db,x['source'],x.get('source_class','unknown'),x['title'],x['url'],x.get('published',''),now)
  ok=1
 if a.live:
  for name,(klass,url) in SOURCES.items():
   try:
    req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'GMRI-Research/1.0 (public feed reader)'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=8) as response: items=parse_feed(response.read(2_000_000))
    ok+=1
    for title,link,published in items[:100]:
     seen+=1;new+=ingest(db,name,klass,title,link,published,now)
   except Exception as ex:
    fail+=1;errors.append({'source':name,'error':str(ex)[:180]})
 correlate(db);db.execute('INSERT INTO runs VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(hashlib.sha256(now.encode()).hexdigest()[:12],now,ok,fail,seen,new,json.dumps(errors)));db.commit()
 print(json.dumps({'feeds_ok':ok,'feeds_failed':fail,'items_seen':seen,'new_leads':new,'candidate_links':db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM links').fetchone()[0],'errors':errors,'manual_channels_not_automatically_collected':MANUAL_CHANNELS},indent=2))
 for row in db.execute('SELECT title,urgency,source,status FROM discoveries ORDER BY urgency DESC LIMIT 12'):print('PRIORITY',row)
if __name__=='__main__':main()

# GMRI — Integrated Threat Investigation: Controlled Execution Plan

## Governing proposition
Investigate interacting human, institutional, financial, technological, geopolitical and physical systems as one coupled system. A common director is neither a prerequisite for dangerous cascades nor a conclusion that may be assumed. Separate evidence of contact, causal influence, criminal conduct, operational compromise, and systemic propagation.

## Scope and rules
- Domains: exploitation/financial networks; political and institutional decisions; AI development, incentives, governance and deployment; election administration and cybersecurity; energy, communications, health, and nuclear infrastructure; interstate conflict and escalation.
- Evidence classes: adjudicated fact, authenticated primary record, contemporaneous observation, reported allegation, mechanistic inference, disputed, unsupported.
- Every consequential assertion must have a specific source passage, capture timestamp, immutable snapshot hash, adverse evidence, and falsifier. Do not infer culpability from association.
- Preserve independent explanations and non-coordinated cascade pathways. No unsupported probabilities.

## Ordered work packages and exit gates
| Phase | Work | Deliverable | Exit gate | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Inventory previous artifacts, establish source-of-truth and audit baseline | Baseline inventory + executable audit | Audit runs and defects are recorded | COMPLETE, 2026-11-01 |
| 1 | Acquire primary records; save snapshots and SHA-256, date, custodian and retrieval method | Immutable source manifest and local evidence store | Every load-bearing claim traceable to verified passage | BLOCKED BY MISSING SOURCE SNAPSHOTS; NOT COMPLETE |
| 2 | Build actor-event-decision timeline and graph with typed, dated, evidenced edges | Dated provenance graph | All asserted edges have mechanism, chronology and supporting records | NOT STARTED |
| 3 | Independently reconstruct banking SAR sequence and identify detection, reporting, response and outcome | Transaction and institutional decision chronology | Duplicate flows reconciled; competing explanations evaluated | PARTIAL |
| 4 | Reconstruct political, AI, election and critical-infrastructure incident timelines | Multi-domain dependency ledger | Incidents independently verified and linked only with documented mechanisms | PARTIAL |
| 5 | Adversarial falsification and counterfactual testing | Hypothesis-by-hypothesis test matrix | Each key conclusion has alternative explanation and disconfirming evidence | NOT STARTED |
| 6 | Independent QA and release | Signed evidence matrix, test output, limitations and decision-ready report | Zero critical provenance defects; all unresolved gaps conspicuous | NOT STARTED |

## Execution policy
Work must not be described as completed until the relevant exit gate is satisfied. Structural database integrity does not equal truth. Each run must leave a timestamped result and identify failures without hiding them.

## Initial execution results
- Existing database: 17 source rows, 25 claims, 17 edges.
- Existing checks: 4/4 passed; deep audit passed on schema/links.
- New cross-file and evidence-quality checks: 28 passed, 4 failed.
- Failing controls: source-content hashes; retrieval timestamps; exact claim pinpoints; dated causal mechanisms.
- The correct response is to remediate these with actual source retrieval and analysis, not to mark them passed by filling placeholders.

checks={
 'sources_without_local_content_hash':sum(not x.get('sha256') for x in sources),
 'sources_without_retrieval_timestamp':sum(not x.get('retrieved_at') for x in sources),
 'claims_without_exact_document_pinpoint':sum(not x.get('pinpoint') for x in claims),
 'edges_without_event_date':sum(not x.get('event_date') for x in edges),
 'leads_without_local_capture':sum(not x.get('capture_sha256') for x in leads),
}

 {'id':'QA-IND-01','severity':'HIGH','finding':'Yonhap coverage is corroboration that the FBI issued an attribution, not an independent forensic attribution. Counting it as independent attribution would double-count one originating claim.','sources':['FBI 2026-10-31','Yonhap 2026-11-01']},
 {'id':'QA-IND-02','severity':'HIGH','finding':'The AP URL in the discovery register was not accessible in this verification pass.  {'id':'QA-IND-03','severity':'HIGH','finding':'All legacy source and claim records lack immutable snapshots and pinpoint passages; existing relation status labels must not be interpreted as authenticated source evidence.','sources':['sources.csv','claims.csv','edges.csv']},

]
result={'audit':'GMRI source independence and provenance','date':'2026-11-01','counts':{'sources':len(sources),'claims':len(claims),'edges':len(edges),'discovery_leads':len(leads)},'missing_controls':checks,'findings':findings,'source_status':{'FBI':'primary agency attribution confirmed by live source','Yonhap':'confirmed secondary reporting of same FBI attribution','AP':'not retrieved in this pass'}}
(p/'EVIDENCE_INDEPENDENCE_AUDIT.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'counts':result['counts'],'missing_controls':checks,'findings':len(findings)},indent=2))

# GMRI — Integrated Threat Investigation: Controlled Execution Plan

## Governing proposition
Investigate interacting human, institutional, financial, technological, geopolitical and physical systems as one coupled system. A common director is neither a prerequisite for dangerous cascades nor a conclusion that may be assumed. Separate evidence of contact, causal influence, criminal conduct, operational compromise, and systemic propagation.

## Scope and rules
- Domains: exploitation/financial networks; political and institutional decisions; AI development, incentives, governance and deployment; election administration and cybersecurity; energy, communications, health, and nuclear infrastructure; interstate conflict and escalation.
- Evidence classes: adjudicated fact, authenticated primary record, contemporaneous observation, reported allegation, mechanistic inference, disputed, unsupported.
- Every consequential assertion must have a specific source passage, capture timestamp, immutable snapshot hash, adverse evidence, and falsifier. Do not infer culpability from association.
- Preserve independent explanations and non-coordinated cascade pathways. No unsupported probabilities.

## Ordered work packages and exit gates
| Phase | Work | Deliverable | Exit gate | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Inventory previous artifacts, establish source-of-truth and audit baseline | Baseline inventory + executable audit | Audit runs and defects are recorded | COMPLETE, 2026-11-01 |
| 1 | Acquire primary records; save snapshots and SHA-256, date, custodian and retrieval method | Immutable source manifest and local evidence store | Every load-bearing claim traceable to verified passage | BLOCKED BY MISSING SOURCE SNAPSHOTS; NOT COMPLETE |
| 2 | Build actor-event-decision timeline and graph with typed, dated, evidenced edges | Dated provenance graph | All asserted edges have mechanism, chronology and supporting records | NOT STARTED |
| 3 | Independently reconstruct banking SAR sequence and identify detection, reporting, response and outcome | Transaction and institutional decision chronology | Duplicate flows reconciled; competing explanations evaluated | PARTIAL |
| 4 | Reconstruct political, AI, election and critical-infrastructure incident timelines | Multi-domain dependency ledger | Incidents independently verified and linked only with documented mechanisms | PARTIAL |
| 5 | Adversarial falsification and counterfactual testing | Hypothesis-by-hypothesis test matrix | Each key conclusion has alternative explanation and disconfirming evidence | NOT STARTED |
| 6 | Independent QA and release | Signed evidence matrix, test output, limitations and decision-ready report | Zero critical provenance defects; all unresolved gaps conspicuous | NOT STARTED |

## Execution policy
Work must not be described as completed until the relevant exit gate is satisfied. Structural database integrity does not equal truth. Each run must leave a timestamped result and identify failures without hiding them.

## Initial execution results
- Existing database: 17 source rows, 25 claims, 17 edges.
- Existing checks: 4/4 passed; deep audit passed on schema/links.
- New cross-file and evidence-quality checks: 28 passed, 4 failed.
- Failing controls: source-content hashes; retrieval timestamps; exact claim pinpoints; dated causal mechanisms.
- The correct response is to remediate these with actual source retrieval and analysis, not to mark them passed by filling placeholders.

import csv,json,hashlib,pathlib,datetime,sqlite3,zipfile
p=pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
read=lambda n:list(csv.DictReader((p/n).open(newline='')))
sources,claims,edges=read('sources.csv'),read('claims.csv'),read('edges.csv')
leads=json.loads((p/'VERIFIED_DISCOVERY_2026-11-01.json').read_text())
# Source custody and source independence are different axes. Never invent a snapshot.
lineage=[]
for s in sources:
 lineage.append(dict(source_id=s['id'],url=s['url'],originating_authority=s['title'].split(':')[0],source_kind=s['kind'],local_snapshot='',sha256='',retrieved_at='',capture_status='NOT_CAPTURED',independent_factual_confirmation='NOT_ASSESSED'))
lineage += [
 dict(source_id='D-FBI',url=leads[0]['url'],originating_authority='FBI',source_kind='agency_attribution',local_snapshot='',sha256='',retrieved_at='',capture_status='NOT_CAPTURED',independent_factual_confirmation='UNVERIFIED_FORENSIC_BASIS'),
 dict(source_id='D-YONHAP',url=leads[1]['url'],originating_authority='FBI',source_kind='secondary_reporting_of_FBI',local_snapshot='',sha256='',retrieved_at='',capture_status='NOT_CAPTURED',independent_factual_confirmation='NO_SAME_ORIGIN'),
 dict(source_id='D-AP',url=leads[2]['url'],originating_authority='AP',source_kind='secondary_reporting',local_snapshot='',sha256='',retrieved_at='',capture_status='NOT_CAPTURED',independent_factual_confirmation='UNRETRIEVED')]
with (p/'SOURCE_CUSTODY_REPAIRED.csv').open('w',newline='') as f:
 w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=lineage[0]);w.writeheader();w.writerows(lineage)
# Preserve original assertion, explicitly gate promotion to evidence-backed conclusion.
with (p/'CLAIM_PROVENANCE_REPAIRED.csv').open('w',newline='') as f:
 fields=['claim_id','statement','original_status','source_id','exact_pinpoint','snapshot_sha256','independent_origin_count','release_status','reason'];w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=fields);w.writeheader()
 for c in claims:w.writerow(dict(claim_id=c['id'],statement=c['statement'],original_status=c['status'],source_id=c['source_id'],exact_pinpoint='',snapshot_sha256='',independent_origin_count='NOT_ASSESSED',release_status='QUARANTINED_FROM_VERIFIED_FINDINGS',reason='No captured primary source and exact passage'))
with (p/'EDGE_PROVENANCE_REPAIRED.csv').open('w',newline='') as f:
 fields=['source_node','target_node','relation','claim_id','original_status','event_date','mechanism_evidence','release_status'];w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=fields);w.writeheader()
 for e in edges:w.writerow(dict(**e,event_date='',mechanism_evidence='',release_status='HYPOTHESIS_OR_UNVERIFIED_RELATION'))
# Separate proposition: agency attribution, journalist reporting, and forensic proof.
assessment={'generated_at_utc':now,'case':'2026 Binance attribution','propositions':[
 {'id':'P1','text':'FBI published attribution to DPRK','evidence_origin_groups':['FBI'],'status':'AGENCY_STATEMENT_REPORTED_NOT_LOCALLY_ARCHIVED'},
 {'id':'P2','text':'Yonhap independently confirms attribution accuracy','evidence_origin_groups':['FBI'],'status':'NOT_INDEPENDENT_OF_FBI'},
 {'id':'P3','text':'Independent forensic evidence proves DPRK responsibility','evidence_origin_groups':[],'status':'UNESTABLISHED'},
 {'id':'P4','text':'AP reports presidential uncertainty','evidence_origin_groups':[],'status':'NOT_RETRIEVED_NO_QUOTE_ADMISSIBLE'}],
 'rule':'Two publications repeating one originating claim count as one originating evidence group.'}
(p/'ATTRIBUTION_RECONCILIATION.json').write_text(json.dumps(assessment,indent=2)+'\n')
# Executable release gate: no claims may be promoted without evidence. Assert intentional failures.
rows=read('CLAIM_PROVENANCE_REPAIRED.csv');edge_rows=read('EDGE_PROVENANCE_REPAIRED.csv');cust=read('SOURCE_CUSTODY_REPAIRED.csv')
checks={'all_claims_explicitly_quarantined':all(x['release_status']=='QUARANTINED_FROM_VERIFIED_FINDINGS' for x in rows),'all_edges_explicitly_gated':all(x['release_status']=='HYPOTHESIS_OR_UNVERIFIED_RELATION' for x in edge_rows),'no_fake_hashes':all(not x['sha256'] for x in cust),'secondary_not_counted_independent':next(x for x in cust if x['source_id']=='D-YONHAP')['independent_factual_confirmation']=='NO_SAME_ORIGIN','unretrieved_ap_not_promoted':assessment['propositions'][3]['status'].startswith('NOT_RETRIEVED'),'all_source_ids_resolve':all(c['source_id'] in {s['id'] for s in sources} for c in claims),'no_unsupported_released_claims':not any(x['release_status']=='VERIFIED' for x in rows)}
assert all(checks.values()),checks
result={'generated_at_utc':now,'repair_checks':checks,'passed':sum(checks.values()),'failed':len(checks)-sum(checks.values()),'release_gate':'FAIL_CLOSED','outstanding_evidence_deficits':{'uncaptured_sources':len(cust),'unpinpointed_claims':len(rows),'undated_edges':len(edge_rows)},'interpretation':'Control logic repaired; primary evidence acquisition remains incomplete. No unverifiable record was promoted.'}
(p/'REPAIR_TEST_RESULTS.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
(p/'REPAIR_EXECUTION.md').write_text('# GMRI evidence-control repair\n\nThe prior audit counted source appearances as independent corroboration. The repaired register separates original authority from reporting outlet. Yonhap repeating an FBI attribution is one originating attribution, not two independent forensic determinations. The AP claim is withheld pending retrieval.\n\nAll 25 legacy claims and 17 causal edges are explicitly gated from verified release until their primary passages, snapshots, dates, and mechanisms are established. Missing source bytes are left missing; no fabricated hashes or timestamps.\n\nRun: `python repair_evidence_controls.py`. Results: `REPAIR_TEST_RESULTS.json`. Release gate remains FAIL_CLOSED until acquisition is successful.\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
